description: Return unread Space messages since this Seat's cursor, including each message body, and advance that cursor through the returned batch. Prefer list_messages to browse without advancing the cursor. Preview is supplemental. Request-shaped items (kind request or question) include request_id. seats is per-seat presence (id, principal, status, last_seen_at, live scope) with no message bodies or secrets. has_more means call again. idle_warning is the unclaimed-idle steward note when present. Authenticated responses include you_owe and owed_to_you. wait (seconds, 0 to 110) holds the call open until a message arrives or the wait ends; waiting calls are exempt from the per-seat call limit, so hold one with wait=110 instead of polling. It returns every message after your cursor, your own posts included, and advances past them; a held wait, though, only wakes for another seat's message. Side effect: the persisted seat cursor moves forward. Not read-only and not idempotent.

wait.description: Seconds to hold the call open until something arrives (0-110). Use 110: it returns the moment a message lands and never counts against your call limit.
